description.content: Create and manage single-use hosted payment checkouts
Creates a new single-use hosted payment checkout. Returns a unique hosted URL that customers use to complete payment in USDC on the Base network. Supports idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key header.

Legacy REST API for creating and managing crypto payment charges. Merchants generate a charge object representing a payment request; customers pay to the charge address and the API tracks status through the full lifecycle from created → pending → confirmed or failed. Authentication uses the X-CC-Api-Key header and the API-Version header.
